result.summary: Fixes the Single Random Draw (SRD) coin selection unit test to properly exercise weight-based eviction tie-breaking. It passes the intended mixed-weight UTXO pool rather than the default pool, adds a second lighter coin, and lowers the maximum selection weight so that evicting heavier coins on equal-value ties is required to succeed.
result.problem: The unit test introduced in PR #33223 does not actually test SRD weight tie-breaking. It constructs `mixed_weight_pool` but accidentally passes `utxo_pool`, and sets a maximum selection weight high enough that no eviction is triggered. Consequently, regressions or complete removal of the tie-breaking logic pass unit and functional tests undetected.
evidence: PR description: 'If you reverse #33223, it still passes 20/20 tests, which means it misses the tie-break'
PR description: 'Other coin selection tests like spend_tests, wallet_send.py, wallet_fundrawtransaction.py do not catch the broken tie-break'
Commit 2ade73da7a diff confirms that the existing test passed `utxo_pool` instead of `mixed_weight_pool` to `TestSRDSuccess`.
result.changed_since_previous: No functional change; the diff patch is now available and confirms the earlier description.
result.card: This PR fixes a wallet unit test to properly exercise weight-based eviction tie-breaking in Single Random Draw (SRD) coin selection. The test added in merged PR #33223 accidentally passed the standard UTXO pool instead of the constructed mixed-weight pool and set a weight limit too loose to trigger evictions, allowing the test to pass even if the tie-breaking logic is completely reverted. By supplying the mixed-weight pool, adding a second light coin, and tightening the maximum selection weight, the test ensures that tie-breaking regressions fail deterministically. The change is confined to wallet unit test code and has no dependencies.

risk.why: A mistake in this PR would only cause unit test failures or false test assertions, with no impact on node or wallet behavior.
